search_window.interpretation: Since prior hourly check; wider publication discovery (past 1–2 days) used to detect late-indexed sources, with candidates required to establish new disruption in the observation window.

searched_categories: sole/last/full-service grocery store loss, closure, fire or disaster
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food assistance interruptions with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.exclusions: Search results were predominantly older incidents (2020–2025), unrelated recovery/openings, generic program reporting, donation/resource material, or undated/unconfirmed disruptions. None met new, documented U.S. access-loss evidence within the hourly search window.
coverage_notes.limitation: Supplementary targeted web-index recall check, not an exhaustive nationwide collector. Search indexing and publication timestamps may lag; no conclusion about primary production collection.
coverage_notes.authority: Production Food Line collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.disposition: No publication, approval, schedule change, or task disablement.
